analyst.summary: Vedant Fashions (Manyavar) remains a high-quality, high-margin market leader in ethnic wedding wear with strong returns on capital and a largely debt-free-in-substance balance sheet, but revenue growth has decelerated to low single digits after the post-pandemic demand surge faded, and the stock has fallen sharply over the past one and two years as the market repriced growth expectations. We rate this a Hold: the quality is real, but growth needs to reaccelerate meaningfully before this re-rates higher, and elevated receivable days in the franchise channel is worth monitoring.
